sessionBooked.subject: Session booked
sessionBooked.title: Session booked
sessionBooked.intro: Hi {{studentName}}, your session was booked successfully.
sessionBooked.note: The credits are on hold. They will be released to the tutor once the session is complete.

sessionConfirmed.subject: Session confirmed
sessionConfirmed.title: Session confirmed
sessionConfirmed.warning: Remember that cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice are refunded at 50%.

sessionCancelled.subject: Session cancelled
sessionCancelled.title: Session cancelled
sessionCancelled.intro: Hi {{userName}}, the following session was cancelled.

sessionReminder.subject: Reminder: you have a session tomorrow
sessionReminder.title: Session reminder
sessionReminder.intro: Hi {{userName}}, this is a reminder that you have a session tomorrow.
sessionReminder.note: Make sure you have a good internet connection before you start.

sessionPendingConfirmation.subject: Confirm your session
sessionPendingConfirmation.title: Confirm your session
sessionPendingConfirmation.intro: Hi {{studentName}}, tutor {{tutorName}} marked the session as complete. Please confirm that you received the tutoring.
sessionPendingConfirmation.warning: If you do not confirm within 24 hours, the payment is released to the tutor automatically.

sessionDisputed.subject: New session dispute
sessionDisputed.title: New session dispute
sessionDisputed.intro: Hi {{adminName}}, student {{studentName}} reported a problem with their session.
sessionDisputed.note: Go to the admin panel to resolve this dispute.

sessionDisputeResolved.subject: Dispute resolved
sessionDisputeResolved.title: Dispute resolved
sessionDisputeResolved.intro: Hi {{userName}}, the administrator resolved the dispute.
sessionDisputeResolved.refunded: The dispute was resolved in your favour. {{amount}} was refunded to your wallet.
sessionDisputeResolved.credited: The dispute was resolved in your favour. {{amount}} was credited to your wallet.

withdrawalRequested.subject: New withdrawal request
withdrawalRequested.title: New withdrawal request
withdrawalRequested.note: Go to the admin panel to approve or reject this request.

withdrawalApproved.subject: Withdrawal approved
withdrawalApproved.title: Withdrawal approved
withdrawalApproved.intro: Hi {{tutorName}}, your withdrawal request was approved.
withdrawalApproved.note: The payment will reach your PayPal account within the next few hours.

withdrawalRejected.subject: Withdrawal request rejected
withdrawalRejected.title: Withdrawal request rejected
withdrawalRejected.intro: Hi {{tutorName}}, your withdrawal request was rejected.
withdrawalRejected.note: The amount is back in your wallet. You can try again.

invitation.subject: {{institutionName}} invited you to Macaw
invitation.title: You have been invited to Macaw
invitation.intro: Hi {{name}}, {{institutionName}} invited you to join as {{role}}.
invitation.introNoName: Hi, {{institutionName}} invited you to join as {{role}}.
invitation.note: Once you accept you can choose your password and sign in.

domainVerification.subject: Verify the domain {{domain}}
domainVerification.title: Verify your domain
domainVerification.intro: Someone asked to verify the domain {{domain}} on Macaw. If that was you, use this code in the admin panel.
domainVerification.warning: If you did not request this verification, ignore this email: without this code nobody can claim your domain.

planUsageWarning.subjectNear: {{institutionName}} is close to its plan limit
planUsageWarning.intro: Hi {{adminName}}, {{institutionName}} is using {{students}} of {{maxStudents}} student seats.
planUsageWarning.noteReached: No new students are admitted until the plan is upgraded. Sessions already booked go ahead as normal.
planUsageWarning.noteNear: Once it is full, new students will not be able to register.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Macaw password
passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: Hi {{name}}, we received a request to change your account password.
passwordReset.expiry: The link expires in {{minutes}} minutes and can only be used once.
passwordReset.ignore: If this was not you, ignore this email: your password has not changed.

emailVerification.subject: Verify your email on Macaw
emailVerification.title: Confirm this email is yours
emailVerification.intro: Hi {{name}}, one step left to finish setting up your account.
emailVerification.note: Until you verify it you can still use Macaw, but you will not get important notices.

tutorVerified.subject: Your tutor profile is verified
tutorVerified.title: Profile verified
tutorVerified.note: Students will see the verified badge on your profile and in search results.
